name: Auto-Tune
author: Vocal Monitor
description: Pro-grade vocal pitch correction. YIN pitch detector (the algorithm Antares/Melodyne use for monophonic) tracks fundamental every ~6 ms with cents-accurate parabolic interpolation. Detected pitch is snapped to the nearest note in the chosen scale (chromatic / major / minor / harmonic / pentatonic), and a Hann-windowed granular shifter applies the correction with a smoothed retune time — instant 'Cher' snap at retune=0, natural pitch correction at higher settings. Voicing gate avoids destroying sibilants and breath; humanize adds ±cents random drift for natural feel.
